entities.summary: Qianlong Emperors, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Qing Dynasty (1722–1796). Preceded by Qianlong Emperor's Ten Great Campaigns expand the empire to its maximum extent and Kangxi Emperor's reign — longest in Chinese history and a golden age. Their legacy influenced Siku Quanshu — largest collection of books in Chinese history — compiled and Taiping Rebellion.
